definition: Four-year adjusted cohort graduation rate (ACGR): share of a 9th-grade cohort (adjusted for transfers) graduating with a regular diploma within 4 years.
methodology: Collect district ACGR per state; allocate to ZIP via data/indicators/crosswalks/school_district_to_zip.csv (population-weighted).
match_rationale: The 4-year ACGR is the federal standard definition of the high school graduation rate. Geography differs (district, not ZIP), so a crosswalk is required before mapping.
notes: Do NOT substitute ACS 'HS diploma or higher (adults 25+)': that is attainment, Related but Different.

definition: Share of tested students meeting the state proficiency standard; composite = mean of ELA and Math measures.
methodology: Average of edu_k12_ela_proficiency and edu_k12_math_proficiency for the same geography and year.
match_rationale: ELA and Math together are the standard composite for academic proficiency; each alone is only Partial.
notes: State tests and cut scores differ (MN/IA/ND/SD/WI), so raw proficiency is not comparable across states. RECOMMENDED: SEDA cross-state scale or within-state scoring. NEEDS CONFIRMATION.

definition: Chronic absenteeism: share of students missing 10% or more of enrolled school days.
methodology: Collect district chronic-absence rate; allocate to ZIP via crosswalk.
match_rationale: Chronic absence is the standard absenteeism measure. 'Attendance rate' is related but inverse and not interchangeable; researchers must report chronic absence. MN reports 'consistent attendance' (inverse).
